name: bge-reranker-v2-m3-cross-encoder-marketplaces-rus
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3 (config.json max_position_embeddings 8194). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: cross-encoder (XLM-RoBERTa), full bidirectional attention over query+passage
notes: ADDED 2026-10-30. A finetune of BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3, not a new base model: same config.json, same 0.568B parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. No licence tag on the repo, repo created 2026-06-30. Trained on a frozen 1,404/167/165-row Russian marketplace SKU-dedup split; the control row is the base run zero-shot. So this is an in-domain win on a 165-pair test split, nothing more, and the base record's BEIR/MIRACL rows measure a different instrument.

benchmarks.name: SKU dedup test precision
benchmarks.config: Card 'Benchmark Comparison' table, row 'BGE reranker FT' precision 1.000 vs row 'BGE reranker ZS' (the base, zero-shot) 0.927; 2465 frozen pairs, 165-row test split, dev-selected threshold_weighted_cost.
